expected_holocron.notes: Confirmed (Mike, 2026-10-03): no payload is refused for its event time, matching upstream (docs/decisions/0002, Event time; docs/decisions/0005, Event time outcomes). Respond only after the payload is durably committed (briefing, durability). Keep the {cache, sessionId, visitId} shape (briefing, identity). Values come from the identity derivation in docs/decisions/0001, so they will not equal upstream values. More than 5 minutes ahead: Stored as sent and counted in event_time_ahead (docs/decisions/0002, Event time). Known risk: a far-future row is never reached by the 12-month retention cutoff (docs/decisions/0006, Retention cutoff).
